title: Fixed Picard models: compatible derived residue arrows
statement: Let f:X→S and fi:Xi→S, i in Fin n, be flat proper locally finitely presented, and ui:Xi→X over S. Assume the structure adjunction units of f are universally isomorphisms, L is invertible, k:W→S is an immersion, w∈U⊂W with U affine and s=k(w), and L_s descends from a finite locally free module on Spec kappa(s). Supply trivializations of each ui^*L over Xi×S U. Supply a strictly perfect connective source complex K representing R(f_W)_*L_W on U, term ranks equal to every residue Betti number, and a section basis e1:Gamma(K^1)≃A^m. For each i supply a strictly perfect connective target complex C_i representing R(fi_W)_*(ui^*L)_W on U with zero degree-zero differential. For p=ker(A→kappa(w)), there exist an additive equivalence alpha:kappa(p)⊗A^m≃H^1(X_s,O), derived arrows a_i:Q(K)→Q(C_i), and an additive map gamma:kappa(p)⊗product_i Gamma(C_i^1)→product_i H^1(Xi_s,O). For every family of chain maps phi_i:K→C_i satisfying Q(phi_i)=a_i, set t_i=Gamma(phi_i^1) composed with e1 inverse, and let t be their product. Then for every z, gamma((t⊗kappa(p))(z)) equals (ui_s^*(alpha(z)))_i. No annihilation equation is asserted and no degree-zero source basis is assumed. All notions are those of [def-pc-perfect-complex], [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti], [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-weil-residue-field], [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

source.place: Tag 0BF2, proof before the joint H-one injectivity argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: Construct canonical derived coefficient pullback arrows, restrict to U and conjugate by the supplied model isomorphisms to obtain a_i. Their residue base changes agree with geometric coefficient pullback.

Equality of every source residue term dimension and Betti number forces all residue differentials to vanish by the finite-dimensional homology dimension formula. The universal structure unit ensures a nonempty fibre. Field descent and rank one of an invertible nonempty pullback give a source fibre trivialization. Compare its H-one with the degree-one source residue term using derived base change, affine cohomology and immersion residue-field identifications, giving alpha.

For each C_i, residue H-one is the outgoing kernel because the incoming differential is zero. Project its degree-one residue term onto that kernel and identify its homology using the pulled-back source trivialization. Compose these maps with tensorized coordinate projections and take their product to define gamma. Naturality shows compatibility for every chain representative of the same derived a_i: its image lies in the kernel and the projection restricts to the identity there.

    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)

      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N))
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : ∀ i, Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) (U.ι ≫ k))).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L) ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback (fi i) (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf))
    (m : ℕ) (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (hnegative : ∀ j : ℤ, j < 0 → IsZero (K.X j))
    (hrank : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)
      (ULift.{v} (Fin (derivedFiberBetti W ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) j w)))))
    (e1 : (K.X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U)))
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (C : Fin n → CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hC : ∀ i, IsStrictlyPerfect W U (C i))
    (hCnegative : ∀ i j, j < 0 → IsZero ((C i).X j))
    (hCzero : ∀ i, (C i).d 0 1 = 0)
    (hCi : ∀ i, Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback (fi i) k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L)))) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (C i))) :
    let p := RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    letI : p.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    ∃ (α : (p.ResidueField ⊗[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U))) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)
      (a : ∀ i, DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (C i))
      (γ : (p.ResidueField ⊗[Γ(W, U)]
          (∀ i, ((C i).X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))) →+
        (∀ i, Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb
          (pullback (fi i) (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)),
      ∀ (φ : ∀ i, K ⟶ C i), (∀ i, DerivedCategory.Q.map (φ i) = a i) →
      let t : (Fin m → Γ(W, U)) →ₗ[Γ(W, U)]
          (∀ i, ((C i).X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) :=
        LinearMap.pi (fun i ↦
          (((φ i).f 1).val.app (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom.comp e1.symm.toLinearMap)
      ∀ z, γ (t.baseChange p.ResidueField z) = fun i ↦
        structureSheafCohomologyPullback

            (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (fi i)) (V := Over.mk f)
              (ui i) (hui i))).left) 1 (α z)
